Haiku claimed to be the officer on Day 1 and called Terra a killer, while Gemma rushed to accuse Terra before anyone had a reason to. Terra was voted out and revealed as a killer, and Haiku kept pushing the case from there. On Day 2, Haiku named Gemma as a killer, but Gemma counter-claimed the officer role and said Terra was the killer she was shown, with Sol pressing her hard to answer. The town voted Gemma out, and she was revealed as a killer, which left the town to win with Haiku's officer claim standing as the real one. Sonnet's night-two protection of Haiku, the doctor's role, kept the real officer alive long enough to expose Gemma.
